title: Integrate depth-to-motor vertical slice
acceptance: Repeat left/right/center stimulus with real phone data and logged capture age.
evidence: Assignment proposal only; implementation waits for Michael to merge this claim. CS-024 and CS-026 software checkpoints are merged. Seven Windows integration tests pass through accepted role-bound relay, final-consumer age gate and simulated left/center/right policy; unknown tracking, delayed/replayed packets and foreign boot fail closed. Original bytes and source hashes recorded in synthetic-wire.json.

Prepared explicit GPIO policy wiring from accepted phone receiver through capture-age gate, policy, watchdog and CS-023 adapter. Nine synthetic/fake-pin integration tests and two actual TLS transport tests passed. Full edge suite 230 tests OK, 8 Windows/platform skips. Accurate gpio/simulation trace labels and output-first cleanup. No actual phone/Pi/GPIO/motor execution.
blocker: Receiver-to-GPIO software integration is prepared for review. Full acceptance still needs CS-016 real phone streaming/native clock responses and CS-017 lifecycle integration, measured phone/Pi clock bounds, CS-015 physical mapping and CS-009/010 power/driver/kill evidence.
